blind.description: A rectangular carved stone altar or sacrificial table. The top slab features a perimeter groove with runnels/drainage notches on each short end, set above a molded trim. The central body features recessed side panels and a dark reddish-brown horizontal band along the lower trim, resting on a molded rectangular base. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous, textured as weathered dark grey-brown stone with dried red/rust stains across the top and side band.
blind.from_above: A simple horizontal rectangle of mottled dark stone with reddish stains, featuring an inner carved rectangular groove and small drainage cutouts centered on the left and right short edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2.5 feet tall), and about 4.5 to 5 feet long.

notes: Reddish/rust weathered stains on the stone surface; ensure they do not read as fresh blood at closer inspection.
